entities.name: Ivan Stojanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Stojanović was a Catholic priest from Dubrovnik. He wrote the book Dubrovačka Književnost, published in 1900, arguing that the people of Dubrovnik were Roman Catholic by religion, but by language Serbs. He was involved with the literary journal Slovinac.
